executiveSummary: Telemetry backends are partially reachable in this snapshot, which improves confidence for some services but still leaves gaps in cross-signal diagnosis.

likelyRootCauseHypotheses.description: Telemetry coverage is good enough to investigate actively, but still uneven enough that some dependency chains could remain opaque.

contradictoryOrMissingEvidence.signal: Service-level latency, span error rates, and retention guarantees are not proven by reachability alone.

Confirm whether Jaeger spans cover the same services seen in Kubernetes traffic paths.
Validate retention, scrape completeness, and alert coverage before treating telemetry as fully production-grade.

shortTerm.title: Use the reachable Loki and Jaeger backends to verify whether checkout-api errors align with dependency latency or rollout events
shortTerm.expectedBenefit: Turns partial telemetry reachability into actionable incident triage instead of relying only on kubectl snapshots.

preventive.title: Strengthen telemetry completeness checks so backend reachability and scrape/query coverage are validated separately
preventive.expectedBenefit: Improves confidence that runtime adapters reflect real production observability, not just reachable endpoints.
preventive.riskTradeoff: Requires more backend-specific validation logic and scenario coverage.
preventive.rollbackOutline: Revert added checks if they are too noisy or too vendor-specific.

proposedOperatorMessage: Kube Ops Copilot: Loki and Jaeger are queryable in this snapshot, so checkout-api can now be investigated with real logs and traces instead of cluster shape alone. Best next step is to verify whether the error hotspot aligns with dependency latency or rollout timing.
hiddenRisks: A reachable backend can still have incomplete retention, scrape coverage, or service tagging, so reachability should not be mistaken for perfect observability.
unknowns: This fixture does not prove span completeness or alert coverage.
finalOperatorVerdict: Use the newly confirmed telemetry paths for investigation, but continue to treat backend reachability and telemetry completeness as separate questions.
